# cubepath_kubernetes_addons (Data Source)

Fetches available Kubernetes addons.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `addons` (Attributes List) Available Kubernetes addons. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--addons))
- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier.

<a id="nestedatt--addons"></a>
### Nested Schema for `addons`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Addon category.
- `default_version` (String) Default Helm chart version.
- `description` (String) Addon description.
- `documentation_url` (String) Link to addon documentation.
- `helm_chart` (String) Helm chart name.
- `min_k8s_version` (String) Minimum Kubernetes version required.
- `name` (String) Addon display name.
